name: Gecse (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gecse (a blue shield with a yellow patriarchal cross, an orb and a bunch of grapes on a green mound) below the name GECSE in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
